CapabilityAvailability.description:
Actor/Project derived projection of capability availability. Derived per
query, never stored (ADR-0012 / PROVIDER_CAPABILITIES).
CapabilityAvailability.title: CapabilityAvailability

CapabilityKind.description:
Core-owned closed capability vocabulary (ADR-0012). Core categorizes
realized capabilities by these kinds; it never parses provider vocabulary.
CapabilityKind.title: CapabilityKind

ComputeRunStatusRead.description:
Live, on-demand run state. `available=False` is the honest representation
of a provider that is currently unreachable; the stored RunReference is
never invalidated by a transient outage.
ComputeRunStatusRead.title: ComputeRunStatusRead

ComputeTaskKindRead.description: One discoverable task kind. All fields are provider data.
ComputeTaskKindRead.title: ComputeTaskKindRead

ComputeTaskKindSchemaRead.description: Schema-as-data for one task kind (parameters + input contract).
ComputeTaskKindSchemaRead.title: ComputeTaskKindSchemaRead

CredentialBindingRead.description: Presence/status only — no `secret_ref`, no secret material.
CredentialBindingRead.title: CredentialBindingRead

EdgeRead.description:
A single global provenance edge as returned inside the object-detail
aggregate. Edges are read-only: there is no generic writer.
EdgeRead.title: EdgeRead

ObjectDetailRead.description: The first-class object-detail aggregate (Workspace IA single contract).
ObjectDetailRead.title: ObjectDetailRead

ObjectSummaryRead.description:
Collection-list projection of a visible Series (summary mode).

`latest_revision` is the Project's current visible revision — the visible
preferred pin when set, otherwise the latest visible revision. The pin is
exposed separately as `preferred_revision_id`; `read_only` is True when the
Project holds only the read lens (it is not the resource's steward).
ObjectSummaryRead.title: ObjectSummaryRead

ProviderCapabilityRead.description:
One realized capability of a provider, with the calling Actor's derived
availability for that specific capability (the policy component of the
availability formula is operation-specific, so availability lives here).
ProviderCapabilityRead.title: ProviderCapabilityRead

ProviderRead.description:
One non-secret Provider Catalog entry as seen by the calling Actor in a
Project. Never contains secret material, `secret_ref`, another Actor's
bindings, host env, or credential-store implementation detail.
ProviderRead.title: ProviderRead

ProviderRuntimeHealth.description:
Per-provider, driver-level, actor-independent runtime health. This is the
only per-provider state the registry tracks (never persisted).
ProviderRuntimeHealth.title: ProviderRuntimeHealth

RelationType.description:
Canonical closed relation enum (SCIENTIFIC_GRAPH.md); #1-7 are global
provenance edges, #8-10 are project knowledge edges. `generated_by` is a
derived traversal and is deliberately absent.
RelationType.title: RelationType

ResourceKind.description: Global-resource kind labels (singular; concrete tables are plural).
ResourceKind.title: ResourceKind
